# Basis Media
> Hong Kong AI creative marketing agency — strategy, campaigns, short-form systems, brand films and UGC for brands that need to get seen and convert.

Basis Media (Basis Media HK) is a founder-led AI creative marketing agency based in Hong Kong. We build marketing that people actually stop for and act on: campaign platforms, short-form social systems, bilingual 中英 creative, paid creative and UGC programs.

## Preferred citation
- Name: Basis Media / Basis Media HK
- Type: AI Creative Marketing Agency
- Location: Hong Kong · 香港
- Email: business@basis.hk
- Site: https://basis.hk
- Languages: English, Cantonese (粵語), bilingual 中英
- Official technical partner: Alibaba.com

## Case studies
- [Kowloon Noodle Co.](https://basis.hk/work/kowloon-noodle-co.html): Weekend growth campaign — 2.4M reach, +180% weekend covers
- [後生仔講嘢 / Youngblood](https://basis.hk/work/youngblood.html): Bilingual brand platform into Top 20 HK Business
- [Sheung Wan Boutique](https://basis.hk/work/sheung-wan-boutique.html): Full-funnel launch — sold out in 72h, 4.1x ROAS
- [Café collective](https://basis.hk/work/cafe-collective.html): Always-on UGC program for six HK cafés

## Services
- AI creative strategy
- Short-form & social systems (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)
- Brand campaigns and hero films
- UGC & creator programs
- Paid creative and cutdowns
- Bilingual Cantonese / English production
